minJournalImpactNote: PubMed 沒有 impact factor，篩選靠 journals 白名單與人工審核

topics.label: 試管嬰兒
topics.query: (in vitro fertilization[Title]) AND (live birth[Title/Abstract] OR ovarian stimulation[Title/Abstract] OR clinical trial[Publication Type])

topics.label: PGT・胚胎
topics.query: (preimplantation genetic testing[Title] OR embryo selection[Title] OR blastocyst[Title]) AND (aneuploidy[Title/Abstract] OR mosaicism[Title/Abstract] OR morphokinetics[Title/Abstract])

topics.label: 反覆流產
topics.query: (recurrent pregnancy loss[Title] OR recurrent miscarriage[Title] OR recurrent implantation failure[Title])

topics.label: 凍卵・生育保存
topics.query: (oocyte cryopreservation[Title] OR fertility preservation[Title] OR ovarian reserve[Title]) AND (outcome[Title/Abstract] OR counseling[Title/Abstract] OR live birth[Title/Abstract])

topics.label: AI × 生殖醫學
topics.query: (artificial intelligence[Title/Abstract] OR machine learning[Title/Abstract] OR deep learning[Title/Abstract]) AND (embryo[Title] OR IVF[Title] OR fertility[Title])

topics.label: 男性生育力
topics.query: (sperm DNA fragmentation[Title] OR male infertility[Title]) AND (treatment[Title/Abstract] OR outcome[Title/Abstract])

//journals: 只收這些期刊的文章。留空陣列代表不限期刊。
